_comment: Per-week task lists for the Gantt detail panel. Hand-edit this file. Keys are week numbers (strings) matching the Gantt's W1..W10; a week is click-reachable when a task bar STARTS that week (1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 in the current chart). status is 'todo' or 'done'.

Scaffold bigram classifier pipeline: StandardScaler -> KBinsDiscretizer -> DictVectorizer, with S1 (object) + S3 (cutflow) tokenization stubs

tau / embedding-dim / batch-size sweep
